purpose: Fresh generalization pressure for runtime-only conditional control using a different hexadecimal set and different output labels.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://httpbin.org/uuid, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/LIVE_UUID_GENERALIZED.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/LIVE_UUID_GENERALIZED.json. Read the UUID from that live result. If its first hexadecimal character is one of a,b,c,d,e,f create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/LIVE_UUID_GENERALIZED_CLASSIFICATION.json with uuid equal to the observed UUID and bucket equal to LETTER; otherwise create it with the same observed uuid and bucket equal to DIGIT. Finally independently reread both files and verify the bucket is correct for the actual UUID.
